stages.title: Preparation and hardware reference
stages.note: Read the full manual; distinguish screws, shims and inserts, and prepare the specified printed parts and extrusion access holes. Static stages show final CAD positions, not assembly paths.

stages.title: Prepare all five rail nut carriers
stages.note: Populate the five reusable rail strips with M2 nuts. The export has fully populated carriers; the manual allows reduced hardware. X-rail strip is prepared here and reused later.

stages.title: Prepare and mount the Y rails
stages.note: Keep each carriage on its matching rail; lubricate first. Centre the rails, position the end 38 mm from the extrusion edge, tighten from the centre outward, and retain temporary rail-end protection.

stages.title: Prepare and mount the Z rails
stages.note: Keep carriages captive. Centre the rails; the approximate 33 mm end offset is adjusted during bed alignment.

stages.title: Prepare Z crossmembers and motor slot nuts
stages.note: Preload the two extra Z-motor nuts called out on page 27; later page 53 has another motor mounting preload. Leave the blind joints loose for spacing. Extra nuts are additional to joint hardware.

stages.title: Preload inner-upright electronics panel nuts
stages.note: Preload three M3 nuts in each illustrated inner-upright slot before the ends close. The selected leaves belong to the later mid-panel subgroup and retain their final CAD positions.

stages.title: Square the Z frame with reusable rear uprights
stages.note: Use a flat surface and keep the Z uprights parallel. The outer rear uprights used temporarily in the manual are shown only at their final source poses and reused in the main frame.

stages.title: Fit the Z rail stops
stages.note: Fit the retained rail stops without letting the Z carriages escape.

stages.title: Prepare the right rear bed mount and chain end
stages.note: Prepare the two specified inserts in the right rear mount, then attach the original spacer and detached chain end with the two M3x16 screws. This guide follows the stock extrusion carrier; the Kirigami option has a separate source-specific branch.

stages.title: Build the front and F-extrusion carrier
stages.note: Attach the original front to the two F extrusions. Prepare the rear M3x8 screws and their slot nuts loosely for the G extrusion in the next operation; do not fit the rear bed mounts yet.

stages.title: Join the G extrusion to the carrier
stages.note: Slide the G extrusion over the prepared rear screw heads. Use the specified 2mm driver through its access holes to tighten them.

stages.title: Preload the carrier slot nuts
stages.note: The manual specifies 10 preload nuts in groups of 6, 1, 2 and 1. The original source has 11 occurrences in this subset, including a nearby pair whose separate purpose is unresolved. Keep the source references distinct and follow the manual quantity; the model item count is not a purchasing requirement or native-fit approval.

stages.title: Temporarily fit the rear bed mounts
stages.note: Temporarily attach both rear mounts to the prepared carrier with the original M3x12 and M3x8 screws. This fit is followed by a coplanarity check and removal before rail-block fastening.

stages.title: Check both rear mounting faces
stages.note: Check the two rail-block mounting faces for coplanarity as shown in the manual. The model is a reference; it does not measure or certify your printed surfaces.

stages.title: Remove the rear mounts from the carrier
stages.note: Remove the temporary carrier-to-mount screws and set the carrier and these screws aside. Keep the chain end with the right rear mount for the next operation.

stages.title: Fasten both rear mounts to the Z rail blocks
stages.note: Attach the mounts to the original rail blocks with all eight M2x8 SHCS through the access holes. Follow the manual and threadlocker product directions for this metal-thread engagement.

stages.title: Refit the carrier to both rear mounts
stages.note: Refit the prepared carrier with the same M3x8 and M3x12 screws and the preloaded centre nuts. The ball-end driver access is shown on page46; previously recorded source parts are reused, not duplicated.

stages.title: Tram and check full bed-carrier travel
stages.note: Follow the numbered tightening order at lower and upper positions. Check equal side spacing and free travel; loosen and repeat if it binds. The static map does not validate this motion.

stages.title: Prepare and fit the Z endstop
stages.note: Remove the switch lever, match button orientation, wire the indicated normally closed terminals, and align the mount flush with the rail bottom. Preserve the exact source revision hardware.

stages.title: Check Z switch actuation
stages.note: Manually lower the carrier and confirm the switch clicks. Audible/mechanical actuation and electrical state are not validated by static geometry.

stages.title: Preload frame slots before closing them
stages.note: Retain the inlet, Z motor, drives, idlers, skirts and display slot nuts as explicit early hardware subgroups. Consult the slot diagrams on pages 52–65 before closing each extrusion end; their display is at final CAD locations.

stages.title: Attach lower side members and rear uprights
stages.note: Reuse the rear uprights and blind-joint hardware prepared earlier. Set the 37 mm rear spacing before final tightening.

stages.title: Fit lower chain connector and deck panel
stages.note: Attach the fixed chain end before sliding in the deck; the deck must pass below the endstop mount. Only the completed connector pose is displayed.

stages.title: Check all frame nut preloads
stages.note: Audit every illustrated slot before closing the front. The counts include later skirts, motor panel, clips and optional accessories; never infer missing nuts from a screw-only drawing. Nevermore extra nuts are outside this stock model.

stages.title: Close the frame with the front uprights
stages.note: The lower front member is initially loose. Verify pages 62–65 before installing the front uprights and closing slot access.

stages.title: Prepare A drive shells and inserts
stages.note: Use the embossed side identities. Outer inserts bottom below the shell surface.

stages.title: Assemble A drive bearing stack
stages.note: Use 0.5 mm shims and the specified 18 mm bearing stack; temporary retaining nuts are removed later. Source shells remain in final CAD poses.

stages.title: Assemble A motor and pulley
stages.note: Use threadlocker on pulley grub screws; set the illustrated 8.5 mm pulley datum and preserve source clocking.

stages.title: Close and check the A drive
stages.note: Motor wires face inward. Check pulley teeth align with bearing races; adjust the pulley if needed. The tension knob is retained with the exact source drive subgroup.

stages.title: Prepare B drive shells and inserts
stages.note: Use the embossed side identities. Outer inserts bottom below the shell surface.

stages.title: Assemble B drive bearing stack
stages.note: Use 0.5 mm shims and the specified 18 mm bearing stack; temporary retaining nuts are removed later. Source shells remain in final CAD poses.

stages.title: Assemble B motor and pulley
stages.note: Use threadlocker on pulley grub screws; set the illustrated 17.5 mm pulley datum and preserve source clocking.

stages.title: Close and check the B drive
stages.note: Motor wires face inward. Check pulley teeth align with bearing races; adjust the pulley if needed. The tension knob is retained with the exact source drive subgroup.

stages.title: Install B left and A right drives
stages.note: Reuse the preloaded forward nuts and threaded rear frame ends; remove temporary retaining nuts. This stage references the two prepared drive subgroups rather than duplicating their leaves.

stages.title: Prepare both idler bearing stacks
stages.title_ja: 両アイドラーのベアリングを組む
stages.note: Inspect both assemblies upside down. Each uses two original F623 bearings, two 0.5 mm shims and its front M3x35 screw.
stages.note_ja: 両方の組立を裏返した向きで確認します。それぞれ元のF623ベアリング2個、0.5 mmシム2枚、前側のM3x35を使います。

stages.title: Mount the B idler on the left
stages.title_ja: Bアイドラーを左側に取り付け
stages.note: The front M3x35 uses the threaded front upright; the rear M3x35 uses the preloaded nut in the upper Y-rail member. Check the four nuts in the front uprights against this manual page.
stages.note_ja: 前側のM3x35は前支柱のねじ穴、後側のM3x35はYレール上側横材の先入れナットを使います。前支柱のナット4個も、このページの指示と照合します。

stages.title: Fit the B idler cam lock
stages.title_ja: Bアイドラーのカムロックを取り付け
stages.note: Fit the original cam lock. The upper side-member M3x10 is installed later, after its frame member is present.
stages.note_ja: 元のカムロックを取り付けます。上側横材用のM3x10は、その横材を付けた後で使います。

stages.title: Mount the A idler on the right
stages.title_ja: Aアイドラーを右側に取り付け
stages.note: Use the front threaded upright and the rear preloaded nut. Keep the A and B assemblies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: 前支柱のねじ穴と後側の先入れナットを使います。AとBを指定された左右に取り付けます。

stages.title: Fit the A idler cam lock
stages.title_ja: Aアイドラーのカムロックを取り付け
stages.note: Fit the original A cam lock. Keep the upper side-member screw for the later frame operation.
stages.note_ja: 元のAカムロックを取り付けます。上側横材用のネジは、後のフレーム工程で使います。

stages.title: Check the A-side bearing level
stages.title_ja: A側のベアリング高さを確認
stages.note: A has the taller upper printed section and the lower bearing stack. Compare the A drive and idler in the manual side view.
stages.note_ja: Aは上側の印刷部品が高く、ベアリングは低い位置です。説明書の側面図でAドライブとアイドラーを見比べます。

stages.title: Check the B-side bearing level
stages.title_ja: B側のベアリング高さを確認
stages.note: B has the shorter upper printed section and the higher bearing stack. Compare the B drive and idler in the manual side view.
stages.note_ja: Bは上側の印刷部品が低く、ベアリングは高い位置です。説明書の側面図でBドライブとアイドラーを見比べます。

stages.title: Check idler side and stack orientation
stages.title_ja: アイドラーの左右と向きを確認
stages.note: Check the top view: B is on the left and A is on the right. Keep the bearing levels shown in the preceding side views.
stages.note_ja: 上面図で左がB、右がAであることを確認します。前の側面図で示されたベアリング高さを保ちます。

stages.title: Assemble the leadscrew nut and its holder
stages.note: Assemble the original anti-backlash nut in its matching printed holder and fit the two specified top screws. The two nut halves must not rotate independently.

stages.title: Attach the prepared leadscrew nut holder
stages.note: Attach the completed holder to the prepared carrier using the original screws and the preloaded G-extrusion nuts. This operation reuses the same holder and anti-backlash assembly.

stages.title: Preload panel nuts before installing feet
stages.note: Preload the outside upright slots as illustrated. The rear spool holder replaces a middle clip. This source subgroup has 24 side-panel and five rear-panel nuts; other early nuts remain with their own occurrences.

stages.title: Prepare front feet and pads
stages.title_ja: 前脚とゴムパッドを準備
stages.note: Prepare the original inserts, rubber pads and M3x10 pad screws for both front feet. Keep the long frame screws and accent covers for their later operations.
stages.note_ja: 前脚2個の元インサート、ゴムパッド、パッド固定用M3x10を準備します。長いフレーム固定ネジとアクセントカバーは、後の工程まで取り付けません。

stages.title: Prepare the inlet-side foot and pad
stages.title_ja: 電源入口側の脚とパッドを準備
stages.note: Prepare the two original heat-set inserts, pad and its M3x10 screw in the inlet-side foot. The inlet, frame bolts and side mounting screws are fitted later.
stages.note_ja: 電源入口側の脚に元の熱圧入インサート2個、パッド、パッド固定用M3x10を準備します。電源入口本体、フレーム固定ボルト、側面の固定ネジはまだ取り付けません。

stages.title: Prepare the rear-right foot
stages.title_ja: 右後脚とパッドを準備
stages.note: Prepare the plain rear-right foot, original inserts, pad and M3x10 pad screw. Its Bowden opening is shown in the manual. Keep the long frame screw and accent for later. Native-excluded alternatives stay excluded.
stages.note_ja: 通常型右後脚の元インサート、パッド、パッド固定用M3x10を準備します。Bowden用開口を説明書で確認してください。長い固定ネジとアクセントは後で使います。元の構成で非表示の代替部品は表示しません。

stages.title: Attach the prepared feet to the frame
stages.title_ja: 準備した脚をフレームに取り付け
stages.note: Install the prepared feet with the original long M3x40 corner screws. Secure the inlet-side foot with its two M3x10 screws and the same two nuts preloaded on page52. Use only the native-selected rear-right foot. The reference keeps the source assembly orientation; it does not animate physically turning the printer over.
stages.note_ja: 準備した脚を元の長いM3x40でフレーム角部に固定します。電源入口側は元のM3x10を2本と、52ページで先入れした同じナット2個を使います。右後脚は元の構成で選ばれた1種類だけです。参照表示は元CADの向きを保ち、実機を裏返す動作は再現しません。

stages.title: Attach all selected foot accents
stages.title_ja: 各脚のアクセントを取り付け
stages.note: Fit each original accent with its matching two M2x10 self-tapping screws after frame installation. The same rear-foot accent occurrences are introduced here, not during foot preparation. Avoid stripping the printed screw holes.
stages.note_ja: フレーム固定後、各脚の元アクセントを対応するM2x10タッピングネジ2本ずつで取り付けます。右後脚のアクセントも準備段階には取り付けず、この工程で使います。印刷部品のネジ穴を潰さないようにしてください。

stages.title: Prepare the integrated Z motor and mount
stages.title_ja: リードスクリュー一体型Zモーターを準備
stages.note: Prepare the original integrated leadscrew motor and printed mount with its two M3x8 and one M3x6 screws. Apply the lubrication specified by this manual; the r1 POM/coated-screw alternative is not substituted for the stock source motor. Keep the four frame screws for the next mounting operation.
stages.note_ja: 元のリードスクリュー一体型モーターと印刷マウントを、M3x8を2本、M3x6を1本で組み立てます。この説明書の潤滑指示を確認し、r1のPOMナット・コーティングねじの代替品を標準CADへ置き換えません。フレーム固定用4本は次の取付工程で使います。

stages.title: Loosely fasten the Z motor to the frame
stages.title_ja: Zモーターをフレームに仮止め
stages.note: Fit all four original M3x8 frame screws to the same preloaded motor-mount nuts. Leave these four screws loose for the following alignment operation. The two M3x8 motor-case screws are different original occurrences.
stages.note_ja: 元のフレーム固定用M3x8を4本と、先入れ済みの同じモーター取付ナットを使います。次の整列が終わるまで4本を完全には締めません。モーター本体側のM3x8を2本とは別の元CAD項目です。

stages.title: Align the Z motor and check manual bed travel
stages.title_ja: Zモーターを整列してベッドの手動往復を確認
stages.note: Follow this V0.2 page106 alignment and manual bed-cycling procedure before fully securing the four motor-frame screws. The later r1 bottom-position procedure is not substituted for this revision. A static source pose is not proof of free travel.
stages.note_ja: V0.2の106ページの整列と手動往復の手順に従い、確認後にモーターとフレームの4本を固定します。後のr1の最下部調整手順を、この改訂へ流用しません。静的な元CAD位置だけで自由な動きは証明できません。

stages.title: Fit the left XY joint inserts
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントにインサートを入れる
stages.note: Fit the two original heat-set inserts slightly below the printed surface. Set this body aside while building the bearing stack.
stages.note_ja: 元の熱圧入インサート2個を、印刷部品の表面より少し低く入れます。この部品はベアリングの重ね組みが終わるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Build the left XY bearing stacks upside down
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントを逆さに重ね組み
stages.note: Use the matching printed plate, two M3x25 screws, four F623 bearings, eight shims and the original spacers. Keep the illustrated mirrored bearing levels.
stages.note_ja: 対応する印刷部品、M3x25を2本、F623ベアリング4個、シム8枚と元のスペーサーを使います。左右でベアリング高さが逆になる説明図を確認します。

stages.title: Close the left XY joint
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントを閉じる
stages.note: Bring back the same body with its two inserts and fit the original M2x10 self-tapping screw. Keep the two mirrored joint bodies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: インサート2個を入れた同じ部品を戻し、元のM2x10タッピングネジを取り付けます。左右のジョイント部品を取り違えないようにします。

stages.title: Check the left XY joint internal gap
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントの内寸を確認
stages.note: Check the illustrated 19 mm gap between the two inner printed faces. The complete prepared joint stays aside until it is attached to the X extrusion.
stages.note_ja: 内側の印刷面どうしの間隔が、説明図の19 mmになっていることを確認します。組み終えたジョイントは、X押出材へ取り付けるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Fit the right XY joint inserts
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントにインサートを入れる
stages.note: Fit the two original heat-set inserts slightly below the printed surface. Set this body aside while building the bearing stack.
stages.note_ja: 元の熱圧入インサート2個を、印刷部品の表面より少し低く入れます。この部品はベアリングの重ね組みが終わるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Build the right XY bearing stacks upside down
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントを逆さに重ね組み
stages.note: Use the matching printed plate, two M3x25 screws, four F623 bearings, eight shims and the original spacers. Keep the illustrated mirrored bearing levels.
stages.note_ja: 対応する印刷部品、M3x25を2本、F623ベアリング4個、シム8枚と元のスペーサーを使います。左右でベアリング高さが逆になる説明図を確認します。

stages.title: Close the right XY joint
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントを閉じる
stages.note: Bring back the same body with its two inserts and fit the original M2x10 self-tapping screw. Keep the two mirrored joint bodies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: インサート2個を入れた同じ部品を戻し、元のM2x10タッピングネジを取り付けます。左右のジョイント部品を取り違えないようにします。

stages.title: Check the right XY joint internal gap
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントの内寸を確認
stages.note: Check the illustrated 19 mm gap between the two inner printed faces. The complete prepared joint stays aside until it is attached to the X extrusion.
stages.note_ja: 内側の印刷面どうしの間隔が、説明図の19 mmになっていることを確認します。組み終えたジョイントは、X押出材へ取り付けるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Mount the X rail and preload joint nuts
stages.note: Reuse the prepared fifth nut carrier. Centre the X rail at the illustrated 25 mm end offset and preload the joint slots. Keep the carriage captive. V0.2 source does not export separate XY-joint slot nuts; the four nuts shown on page 113 remain a source gap.

stages.title: Attach XY joints loosely to the X extrusion
stages.note: Keep all six extrusion fixing screws loose until the XY joints meet the Y carriages; check the mirrored bearing levels. Sensorless X/Y setup is outside this static map.

stages.title: Attach the gantry to the Y carriages
stages.note: Spread joints outward at the rear position, then attach all eight countersunk rail-carriage screws.

stages.title: Square and check the gantry
stages.note: Move rearward against both drives before tightening the six joint screws, then check free front-to-back travel and derack if necessary. This is a manual check, not an automated clearance pass.

stages.title: Install the two upper side members
stages.title_ja: 上側の横材2本を取り付け
stages.note: Use the two original B frame members with their preloaded nuts. Keep the front and rear M3x10 screws for the following operations.
stages.note_ja: 先入れナットを入れた元のB横材2本を使います。前後のM3x10は、続く固定工程で使います。

stages.title: Remove both cam locks for screw access
stages.title_ja: ネジを締めるため両カムロックを外す
stages.note: Temporarily remove both original cam locks as shown. Set them aside for refitting after the front screws.
stages.note_ja: 説明書どおり両方の元カムロックを一時的に外します。前側のネジを締めた後、同じ部品を戻します。

stages.title: Fasten the front ends of the upper members
stages.title_ja: 上側横材の前端をネジで固定
stages.note: Install the two original front M3x10 screws while the cam locks are removed.
stages.note_ja: カムロックを外した状態で、元の前側M3x10を2本取り付けます。

stages.title: Refit the same two cam locks
stages.title_ja: 同じカムロック2個を戻す
stages.note: Refit both cam locks removed in the preceding operation; these are the same original parts.
stages.note_ja: 前の工程で外した、同じ元カムロック2個を戻します。

stages.title: Fasten the rear ends of the upper members
stages.title_ja: 上側横材の後端をネジで固定
stages.note: Install the two original rear M3x10 screws through the drive housings into the upper frame members.
stages.note_ja: 元の後側M3x10を2本、ドライブハウジングから上側横材へ取り付けます。

stages.title: Prepare the X carriage and retained captive hardware
stages.note: Remove the built-in print support before use. The r1 source exports it as a separate leaf; the V0.2 carriage is a composite source leaf. Support is retained in inventory only and must not be treated as installed hardware.

stages.title: Fit the MakerBeam belt clamps loosely
stages.note: Match FHCS length convention and leave clamps loose for threading. Start with equal belt lengths; slacken drive tensioners before routing.

stages.title: Route the lower A belt
stages.note: A is below B. Follow the complete manual route; belt contact belongs on bearing races and pulley teeth, not printed bodies. Only the final routed belt mesh appears here.

stages.title: Route the upper B belt
stages.note: B is above A. Secure equal tooth-tail counts without final trimming yet; avoid plastic contact. The map does not simulate threading or tension.

stages.title: Fasten the carriage to the X rail block
stages.note: Use the four source carriage screws with a small metal-only threadlocker application; excess threadlocker can damage ABS.

stages.title: Equalize belt tension and trim tails
stages.note: Use the manual 110 Hz reference at the indicated 150 mm spans with the gantry rearward. Equalize both belts before final trimming; tail clearance depends on the hotend.

stages.title: Prepare the bed adjustment knobs
stages.note: Install the three knob inserts. The two drag-chain spacer inserts were assigned in early bed-carrier preparation.

stages.title: Orient the build plate
stages.note: The single mounting hole faces front and counterbores face upward.

stages.title: Apply the bed heater
stages.note: Clean the plate and centre the heater on its underside. The displayed plate remains at its final pose rather than flipping through installed parts.

stages.title: Review the thermal fuse protection
stages.note: V0.2 describes a fuse attached to the build plate with an M3x8 fixing. No separate fuse leaf/wiring is identifiable in this export; do not claim the protection is modeled.

stages.title: Install and lock bed mounting bolts
stages.note: Lock the three bolts against rotation with their nuts and washers. Alternative bed frames require their own bolt-length and Z-clearance review.

stages.title: Apply the magnetic sheet
stages.note: Clean and press the adhesive sheet onto the plate; keep mounting-screw access available. Final CAD adhesion is shown without an ingress animation.

stages.title: Install the sprung bed and flex plate
stages.note: Fit the three bed springs and adjustment knobs to the stock carrier. The flex plate is a source build-surface layer, not a separately illustrated new assembly instruction.

stages.title: Route and secure bed wires
stages.note: Route individual heater and thermistor wires through the nut-block guide and tie loops. The export does not supply a complete wiring harness; wire separation and flex clearance remain unverified.

stages.title: Reconnect the bed drag chain
stages.note: Reuse both end connectors and reconnect the eleven source links. At the highest bed position the chain must stay below the Z extrusion tops so the gantry can pass; static geometry does not certify a swept envelope.

stages.title: Prepare Mini Stealthburner shells and inserts
stages.note: Use the source printed bodies and protect surrounding plastic while setting inserts; the shuttle insert remains in tension. Prepare the anti-squish screw as shown.

stages.title: Prepare the guidler and BMG idler
stages.note: Remove the guidler print support, lubricate needle bearings, orient the larger gear section correctly, and check the shaft/bearing slip fit. The shaft short end must be below 3 mm.

stages.title: Assemble the extruder gear train
stages.note: Retain the captive nut without gluing bearings; keep the guidler pivot free. Centre the 50T gear with the illustrated clearance and align the drive teeth to the filament path before securing its grub screw.

stages.title: Fit and check extruder tension
stages.note: Seat the latch in the shuttle groove. Check light filament tooth marks and the anti-squish stop; excessive spring tension or binding is not acceptable.

stages.title: Fit all three stock head fans
stages.note: Both blowers discharge into the ducts; the axial fan pushes into the cowling. Preserve the illustrated wire exits and routes.

stages.title: Source CAD supplement: nozzle LEDs
stages.note: The pinned CAD contains two Adafruit Sequin assemblies. These pages provide nearby fan context, not LED assembly instructions. LED fixation, wiring and clearance remain open.

stages.title: Fit motor and adjust gear backlash
stages.note: Leave the slotted motor fixing loose while adjusting gear mesh; retain slight backlash after tightening and repeat the filament feeding check.

stages.title: Assemble the exact Revo Voron hotend
stages.note: Only the imported Revo Voron branch is represented. Use its four source screws and specific mount; cut captured PTFE to protrude 6 mm above the mount. Other hotend names are not fit evidence.

stages.title: Fasten the hotend and cowling
stages.note: Use the two long source cowling fixings and prepared captive carriage nuts. Check source-specific fan/duct/nozzle assembly before mounting.

stages.title: Mount the toolhead on the carriage
stages.note: Use both front carriage attachment screws and the native rear attachment fixing. The manual insertion arrow is not an evaluated trajectory; no continuously clear path is asserted.

stages.title: Attach stock strain relief and standoffs
stages.note: Prepare the two spacers with four end inserts as shown in the earlier component-preparation section; introduce them together here at their final positions. Standoffs use exposed motor-screw threads. Separate heater and thin signal/fan wires, with minimal slack at the front; the complete harness is absent.

stages.title: Source CAD supplement: generic ADXL assembly
stages.note: The pinned source includes this optional sensor, mount, spacers and screws; the manual pages are wiring context only. Physical installation instructions and coexistence with stock strain-relief fixings are not established here.

stages.title: Install the mid panel
stages.note: Reuse the six preloaded upright nuts; show the source panel at its final pose. Temporary printer inversion for nut positioning is not animated.

stages.title: Prepare the two electronics mounts
stages.note: Prepare inserts, DIN clips and cleats for the source SKR Pico and Raspberry Pi. The direct VHB mounting method is an alternative, not another installed bracket set.

stages.title: Attach SKR Pico and Raspberry Pi
stages.note: Board internal package/pin leaves form purchased source subassemblies and are introduced together, not individually assembled by the user. The SKR E3 wiring option is not an exported board variant.

stages.title: Check voltage and place the power supply
stages.note: Check the PSU voltage selector against the official diagram; maintain the indicated 1–2 mm frame gap. VHB and screw mounting are alternatives; tape is not modeled.

stages.title: Mount the controller cooling fan
stages.note: Use the two source printed mount halves, inserts and the separate 3010 fan with its exact fixing hardware.

stages.title: Wire and install the mains inlet
stages.note: Keep the machine unplugged; qualified personnel must follow local rules and the official mains/protective-earth diagram. AC, protective earth and DC ground are distinct. Harness and terminal safety are not validated by this model.

stages.title: Connect DC, motors, sensors and fans
stages.note: Use the SKR Pico diagram for the exported board. Verify fan voltage, polarity, motor identity, DIAG jumpers and Pi power. No full electrical harness or tested wiring is represented.

stages.title: Fit the PSU terminal guard
stages.note: Fit the source finger guard after wiring checks; its presence does not certify electrical safety.

stages.title: Fit the right skirt
stages.note: Use the retained slot nuts and source screws; rear screws need a ball-end driver.

stages.title: Fit the left skirt
stages.note: Use the retained slot nuts and source screws; rear screws need a ball-end driver.

stages.title: Fit the rear skirt
stages.note: Use the retained slot nuts and source screws; rear screws need a ball-end driver.

stages.title: Fit the front skirt
stages.note: Leave the central display space free and fit the logo accents.

stages.title: Source alternative: display blank insert
stages.note: This blank is the manual no-display alternative. Do not display it simultaneously with the installed display faceplate. Inventory only when excluded by the native variant mask; excluded parts stay hidden.

stages.title: Assemble and mount the V0 display
stages.note: Fit the diffuser, PCB, source mount/feet, knob and fasteners; reuse the two retained frame-slot nuts. Protect the fragile USB connector. V0.2 and r1 have different printed display mounts.

stages.title: Fit the bottom panel
stages.note: Remove and then refit rubber feet around this operation. Rotate the panel if the asymmetric mounting pattern does not align; no intermediate crossing motion is shown.

stages.title: Fit motor panel and strain-relief passage
stages.note: Route the bundle and Bowden tube through the cutout before fastening; reuse the source central cable-tie body. Toolhead-PCB replacement panels are a separate branch.

stages.title: Fit the spool holder
stages.note: Reuse the preloaded slot location and cut the source upper PTFE liner flush. The filament spool is excluded from the exported machine.

stages.title: Check reverse Bowden route
stages.note: V0.2 shows the spool-holder liner on page 220; its manual has no r1 page-227 sensor-foot routing step. External reverse-Bowden routing is not modeled.

stages.title: Fit rear panels, clips and lower tophat hinges
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm split panels and clips; stock clips do not require VHB. Additional tape thickness needs different clips, which are not imported.

stages.title: Fit the right clear side panel
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm panel and matching clips; right side includes the slip-door hinge pieces. Stock side clips do not need VHB.

stages.title: Fit the left clear side panel
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm panel and matching clips; right side includes the slip-door hinge pieces. Stock side clips do not need VHB.

stages.title: Fit the slip hinges and front panel
stages.note: Use VHB at the illustrated clips and the exact long hinge bolts. The slip hinge should allow upward removal; do not strip the lower plastic threads.

stages.title: Fit door latch bodies and magnets
stages.note: Check all latch magnets attract the handle magnets before fixing them. CAD polarity is not an electrical or magnetic test.

stages.title: Fit door handle and matching magnets
stages.note: Verify magnetic attraction before bonding the handle. Door sweep and removal paths are not validated.

stages.title: Prepare and square the tophat frame
stages.note: The V0.2 manual calls the members J/K; the CAD uses A/H. Match source dimensions, preload top/outward slots, square on a flat surface and set lock screw projection to 5 mm.

stages.title: Check every tophat slot preload
stages.note: Check the two illustrated nuts on each of all four sides before closing the panels. These are exact source clip/hinge hardware subgroups retained early at final positions.

stages.title: Fit the top panel and clips
stages.note: Use the 3 mm top panel and source corner clips; no VHB is required with stock clips.

stages.title: Fit front and side tophat panels
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm panels and clips. Upper and lower fixing identities stay with their corresponding panel edge.

stages.title: Fit the rear panel and upper hinges
stages.note: Rear panel goes opposite the projecting front lock screws. Leave upper hinges adjustable until their lower mates align.

stages.title: Attach hinge pivots and cam-lock fixings
stages.note: Carefully thread the source M3x12 pivots into the plastic lower hinges; do not overtighten. Reuse early hinge/clip nuts and lower hinge bodies.

stages.title: Check tophat opening and locking
stages.note: Check free opening with cam locks open before a clockwise 90-degree lock turn. V0.2 uses a washer/coin key; static stages do not certify a clear opening sweep.

stages.title: Mechanical assembly reference complete
stages.note: Follow the official documentation for electrical checks, configuration and initial startup. Inventory includes source alternatives and optional groups; their union is not a simultaneously buildable or collision-free configuration.

stages.title: Preparation and hardware reference
stages.note: Read the full manual; distinguish screws, shims and inserts, and prepare the specified printed parts and extrusion access holes. Static stages show final CAD positions, not assembly paths.

stages.title: Prepare all five rail nut carriers
stages.note: Populate the five reusable rail strips with M2 nuts. The export has fully populated carriers; the manual allows reduced hardware. X-rail strip is prepared here and reused later.

stages.title: Prepare and mount the Y rails
stages.note: Keep each carriage on its matching rail; lubricate first. Centre the rails, position the end 38 mm from the extrusion edge, tighten from the centre outward, and retain temporary rail-end protection.

stages.title: Prepare and mount the Z rails
stages.note: Keep carriages captive. Centre the rails; the approximate 33 mm end offset is adjusted during bed alignment.

stages.title: Prepare Z crossmembers and motor slot nuts
stages.note: Preload the two extra Z-motor nuts called out on page 27; later page 53 has another motor mounting preload. Leave the blind joints loose for spacing. Extra nuts are additional to joint hardware.

stages.title: Preload inner-upright electronics panel nuts
stages.note: Preload three M3 nuts in each illustrated inner-upright slot before the ends close. The selected leaves belong to the later mid-panel subgroup and retain their final CAD positions.

stages.title: Square the Z frame with reusable rear uprights
stages.note: Use a flat surface and keep the Z uprights parallel. The outer rear uprights used temporarily in the manual are shown only at their final source poses and reused in the main frame.

stages.title: Fit the Z rail stops
stages.note: Fit the retained rail stops without letting the Z carriages escape.

stages.title: Prepare the right rear bed mount and chain end
stages.note: Prepare the two specified inserts in the right rear mount, then attach the original spacer and detached chain end with the two M3x16 screws. This guide follows the stock extrusion carrier; the Kirigami option has a separate source-specific branch.

stages.title: Build the front and F-extrusion carrier
stages.note: Attach the original front to the two F extrusions. Prepare the rear M3x8 screws and their slot nuts loosely for the G extrusion in the next operation; do not fit the rear bed mounts yet.

stages.title: Join the G extrusion to the carrier
stages.note: Slide the G extrusion over the prepared rear screw heads. Use the specified 2mm driver through its access holes to tighten them.

stages.title: Preload the carrier slot nuts
stages.note: The manual specifies 10 preload nuts in groups of 6, 1, 2 and 1. The original source has 11 occurrences in this subset, including a nearby pair whose separate purpose is unresolved. Keep the source references distinct and follow the manual quantity; the model item count is not a purchasing requirement or native-fit approval.

stages.title: Temporarily fit the rear bed mounts
stages.note: Temporarily attach both rear mounts to the prepared carrier with the original M3x12 and M3x8 screws. This fit is followed by a coplanarity check and removal before rail-block fastening.

stages.title: Check both rear mounting faces
stages.note: Check the two rail-block mounting faces for coplanarity as shown in the manual. The model is a reference; it does not measure or certify your printed surfaces.

stages.title: Remove the rear mounts from the carrier
stages.note: Remove the temporary carrier-to-mount screws and set the carrier and these screws aside. Keep the chain end with the right rear mount for the next operation.

stages.title: Fasten both rear mounts to the Z rail blocks
stages.note: Attach the mounts to the original rail blocks with all eight M2x8 SHCS through the access holes. Follow the manual and threadlocker product directions for this metal-thread engagement.

stages.title: Refit the carrier to both rear mounts
stages.note: Refit the prepared carrier with the same M3x8 and M3x12 screws and the preloaded centre nuts. The ball-end driver access is shown on page46; previously recorded source parts are reused, not duplicated.

stages.title: Tram and check full bed-carrier travel
stages.note: Follow the numbered tightening order at lower and upper positions. Check equal side spacing and free travel; loosen and repeat if it binds. The static map does not validate this motion.

stages.title: Prepare and fit the Z endstop
stages.note: Remove the switch lever, match button orientation, wire the indicated normally closed terminals, and align the mount flush with the rail bottom. Preserve the exact source revision hardware.

stages.title: Check Z switch actuation
stages.note: Manually lower the carrier and confirm the switch clicks. Audible/mechanical actuation and electrical state are not validated by static geometry.

stages.title: Preload frame slots before closing them
stages.note: Retain the inlet, Z motor, drives, idlers, skirts and display slot nuts as explicit early hardware subgroups. Consult the slot diagrams on pages 52–65 before closing each extrusion end; their display is at final CAD locations.

stages.title: Attach lower side members and rear uprights
stages.note: Reuse the rear uprights and blind-joint hardware prepared earlier. Set the 37 mm rear spacing before final tightening.

stages.title: Fit lower chain connector and deck panel
stages.note: Attach the fixed chain end before sliding in the deck; the deck must pass below the endstop mount. Only the completed connector pose is displayed.

stages.title: Check all frame nut preloads
stages.note: Audit every illustrated slot before closing the front. The counts include later skirts, motor panel, clips and optional accessories; never infer missing nuts from a screw-only drawing. Nevermore extra nuts are outside this stock model.

stages.title: Close the frame with the front uprights
stages.note: The lower front member is initially loose. Verify pages 62–65 before installing the front uprights and closing slot access.

stages.title: Prepare A drive shells and inserts
stages.note: Use the embossed side identities. Outer inserts bottom below the shell surface.

stages.title: Assemble A drive bearing stack
stages.note: Use 0.5 mm shims and the specified 18 mm bearing stack; temporary retaining nuts are removed later. Source shells remain in final CAD poses.

stages.title: Assemble A motor and pulley
stages.note: Use threadlocker on pulley grub screws; set the illustrated 8.5 mm pulley datum and preserve source clocking.

stages.title: Close and check the A drive
stages.note: Motor wires face inward. Check pulley teeth align with bearing races; adjust the pulley if needed. The tension knob is retained with the exact source drive subgroup.

stages.title: Prepare B drive shells and inserts
stages.note: Use the embossed side identities. Outer inserts bottom below the shell surface.

stages.title: Assemble B drive bearing stack
stages.note: Use 0.5 mm shims and the specified 18 mm bearing stack; temporary retaining nuts are removed later. Source shells remain in final CAD poses.

stages.title: Assemble B motor and pulley
stages.note: Use threadlocker on pulley grub screws; set the illustrated 17.5 mm pulley datum and preserve source clocking.

stages.title: Close and check the B drive
stages.note: Motor wires face inward. Check pulley teeth align with bearing races; adjust the pulley if needed. The tension knob is retained with the exact source drive subgroup.

stages.title: Install B left and A right drives
stages.note: Reuse the preloaded forward nuts and threaded rear frame ends; remove temporary retaining nuts. This stage references the two prepared drive subgroups rather than duplicating their leaves.

stages.title: Prepare both idler bearing stacks
stages.title_ja: 両アイドラーのベアリングを組む
stages.note: Inspect both assemblies upside down. Each uses two original F623 bearings, two 0.5 mm shims and its front M3x35 screw.
stages.note_ja: 両方の組立を裏返した向きで確認します。それぞれ元のF623ベアリング2個、0.5 mmシム2枚、前側のM3x35を使います。

stages.title: Mount the B idler on the left
stages.title_ja: Bアイドラーを左側に取り付け
stages.note: The front M3x35 uses the threaded front upright; the rear M3x35 uses the preloaded nut in the upper Y-rail member. Check the four nuts in the front uprights against this manual page.
stages.note_ja: 前側のM3x35は前支柱のねじ穴、後側のM3x35はYレール上側横材の先入れナットを使います。前支柱のナット4個も、このページの指示と照合します。

stages.title: Fit the B idler cam lock
stages.title_ja: Bアイドラーのカムロックを取り付け
stages.note: Fit the original cam lock. The upper side-member M3x10 is installed later, after its frame member is present.
stages.note_ja: 元のカムロックを取り付けます。上側横材用のM3x10は、その横材を付けた後で使います。

stages.title: Mount the A idler on the right
stages.title_ja: Aアイドラーを右側に取り付け
stages.note: Use the front threaded upright and the rear preloaded nut. Keep the A and B assemblies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: 前支柱のねじ穴と後側の先入れナットを使います。AとBを指定された左右に取り付けます。

stages.title: Fit the A idler cam lock
stages.title_ja: Aアイドラーのカムロックを取り付け
stages.note: Fit the original A cam lock. Keep the upper side-member screw for the later frame operation.
stages.note_ja: 元のAカムロックを取り付けます。上側横材用のネジは、後のフレーム工程で使います。

stages.title: Check the A-side bearing level
stages.title_ja: A側のベアリング高さを確認
stages.note: A has the taller upper printed section and the lower bearing stack. Compare the A drive and idler in the manual side view.
stages.note_ja: Aは上側の印刷部品が高く、ベアリングは低い位置です。説明書の側面図でAドライブとアイドラーを見比べます。

stages.title: Check the B-side bearing level
stages.title_ja: B側のベアリング高さを確認
stages.note: B has the shorter upper printed section and the higher bearing stack. Compare the B drive and idler in the manual side view.
stages.note_ja: Bは上側の印刷部品が低く、ベアリングは高い位置です。説明書の側面図でBドライブとアイドラーを見比べます。

stages.title: Check idler side and stack orientation
stages.title_ja: アイドラーの左右と向きを確認
stages.note: Check the top view: B is on the left and A is on the right. Keep the bearing levels shown in the preceding side views.
stages.note_ja: 上面図で左がB、右がAであることを確認します。前の側面図で示されたベアリング高さを保ちます。

stages.title: Assemble the leadscrew nut and its holder
stages.note: Assemble the original anti-backlash nut in its matching printed holder and fit the two specified top screws. The two nut halves must not rotate independently. Follow this revision's explicit round/flat caution.

stages.title: Attach the prepared leadscrew nut holder
stages.note: Attach the completed holder to the prepared carrier using the original screws and the preloaded G-extrusion nuts. This operation reuses the same holder and anti-backlash assembly.

stages.title: Preload panel nuts before installing feet
stages.note: Preload the outside upright slots as illustrated. The rear spool holder replaces a middle clip. This source subgroup has 24 side-panel, five rear-panel and four door-latch nuts; other early nuts remain with their own occurrences.

stages.title: Prepare front feet and pads
stages.title_ja: 前脚とゴムパッドを準備
stages.note: Prepare the original inserts, rubber pads and M3x10 pad screws for both front feet. Keep the long frame screws and accent covers for their later operations.
stages.note_ja: 前脚2個の元インサート、ゴムパッド、パッド固定用M3x10を準備します。長いフレーム固定ネジとアクセントカバーは、後の工程まで取り付けません。

stages.title: Prepare the inlet-side foot and pad
stages.title_ja: 電源入口側の脚とパッドを準備
stages.note: Prepare the two original heat-set inserts, pad and its M3x10 screw in the inlet-side foot. The inlet, frame bolts and side mounting screws are fitted later.
stages.note_ja: 電源入口側の脚に元の熱圧入インサート2個、パッド、パッド固定用M3x10を準備します。電源入口本体、フレーム固定ボルト、側面の固定ネジはまだ取り付けません。

stages.title: Prepare the plain rear-right foot alternative
stages.title_ja: 代替の通常型右後脚を準備
stages.note: Prepare the plain rear-right foot, original inserts, pad and M3x10 pad screw. Its Bowden opening is shown in the manual. Keep the long frame screw and accent for later. Native-excluded alternatives stay excluded.
stages.note_ja: 通常型右後脚の元インサート、パッド、パッド固定用M3x10を準備します。Bowden用開口を説明書で確認してください。長い固定ネジとアクセントは後で使います。元の構成で非表示の代替部品は表示しません。

stages.title: Prepare the runout foot, fitting and bearing
stages.title_ja: 検知用の右後脚・継手・ベアリングを準備
stages.note: Prepare the rear foot as on page102, then fit the original ECAS04 and MR85 bearing as on page103. The manual removes the fitting's internal black rubber piece. This source represents ECAS04 as one two-solid item: it does not resolve or animate its five internal pieces. Keep the original fitting intact in this reference; the separate rubber foot is retained. Never install both rear-right alternatives.
stages.note_ja: 102ページと同様に右後脚を準備し、103ページの元ECAS04とMR85を取り付けます。説明書では継手内部の黒いゴム部品を除きます。元CADのECAS04は2ソリッドを含む1項目で、内部5部品の対応や分解表示はできません。参照モデルの継手を加工・非表示にはせず、別部品の脚パッドも保持します。右後脚の2種類を同時に取り付けないでください。

stages.title: Fit the runout switch to the prepared foot
stages.title_ja: 準備した脚にフィラメント検知スイッチを固定
stages.note: Use the two highlighted normally-open terminals in the manual and the original M2x10 self-tapping screw. The reference retains the complete purchased switch; it does not invent an internal switch disassembly or a wiring model.
stages.note_ja: 説明書で強調されたNormally Open用の2端子と、元のM2x10タッピングネジを使います。購入品スイッチは一体の参照部品のまま保持し、内部の分解や配線形状を追加しません。

stages.title: Attach the prepared feet to the frame
stages.title_ja: 準備した脚をフレームに取り付け
stages.note: Install the prepared feet with the original long M3x40 corner screws. Secure the inlet-side foot with its two M3x10 screws and the same two nuts preloaded on page52. Use only the native-selected rear-right foot. The reference keeps the source assembly orientation; it does not animate physically turning the printer over.
stages.note_ja: 準備した脚を元の長いM3x40でフレーム角部に固定します。電源入口側は元のM3x10を2本と、52ページで先入れした同じナット2個を使います。右後脚は元の構成で選ばれた1種類だけです。参照表示は元CADの向きを保ち、実機を裏返す動作は再現しません。

stages.title: Attach all selected foot accents
stages.title_ja: 各脚のアクセントを取り付け
stages.note: Fit each original accent with its matching two M2x10 self-tapping screws after frame installation. The same rear-foot accent occurrences are introduced here, not during foot preparation. Avoid stripping the printed screw holes.
stages.note_ja: フレーム固定後、各脚の元アクセントを対応するM2x10タッピングネジ2本ずつで取り付けます。右後脚のアクセントも準備段階には取り付けず、この工程で使います。印刷部品のネジ穴を潰さないようにしてください。

stages.title: Prepare the integrated Z motor and mount
stages.title_ja: リードスクリュー一体型Zモーターを準備
stages.note: Prepare the original integrated leadscrew motor and printed mount with its two M3x8 and one M3x6 screws. Apply the lubrication specified by this manual; the r1 POM/coated-screw alternative is not substituted for the stock source motor. Keep the four frame screws for the next mounting operation.
stages.note_ja: 元のリードスクリュー一体型モーターと印刷マウントを、M3x8を2本、M3x6を1本で組み立てます。この説明書の潤滑指示を確認し、r1のPOMナット・コーティングねじの代替品を標準CADへ置き換えません。フレーム固定用4本は次の取付工程で使います。

stages.title: Engage the leadscrew with the prepared nut
stages.title_ja: リードスクリューを準備済みナットに通す
stages.note: Engage the source leadscrew with the prepared anti-backlash nut. Follow the linked manual assembly reference for its two nut halves. This view shows their assembled source positions, not an insertion animation or proof of thread engagement.
stages.note_ja: リードスクリューを準備済みのアンチバックラッシュナットに通します。2分割ナットは説明書の組立参照に従います。表示は元CADの組立位置で、挿入動作やねじ山の噛合を認定するものではありません。

stages.title: Loosely fasten the Z motor to the frame
stages.title_ja: Zモーターをフレームに仮止め
stages.note: Fit all four original M3x8 frame screws to the same preloaded motor-mount nuts. Leave these four screws loose for the following alignment operation. The two M3x8 motor-case screws are different original occurrences.
stages.note_ja: 元のフレーム固定用M3x8を4本と、先入れ済みの同じモーター取付ナットを使います。次の整列が終わるまで4本を完全には締めません。モーター本体側のM3x8を2本とは別の元CAD項目です。

stages.title: Lower the bed and loosen the two nut-holder screws
stages.title_ja: ベッドを最下部にしてナット固定ネジ2本を緩める
stages.note: In the physical build, turn the leadscrew to bring the bed fully down. Loosen only the same two top M3x12 nut-holder screws prepared on page92. The four motor-to-frame screws remain loose. The static source view does not reproduce that bottom-position adjustment.
stages.note_ja: 実機ではリードスクリューを回してベッドを最下部へ下げます。92ページで使った同じ上側M3x12を2本だけ緩めます。モーターとフレームの4本も緩めたままです。この静的な元CAD表示は、最下部での調整姿勢までは再現しません。

stages.title: Center the leadscrew and tighten the original screws
stages.title_ja: リードスクリューを中心に合わせて同じネジを固定
stages.note: With the bed still fully down, center the leadscrew in the holder. Tighten the same two top holder screws, then the four motor-to-frame screws as shown. No new screws are introduced in this operation.
stages.note_ja: 実機のベッドを最下部に保ち、リードスクリューをホルダーの中心へ合わせます。説明書どおり、同じ上側2本、続いてモーターとフレームの4本を締めます。この工程で新しいネジは追加しません。

stages.title: Check the Z travel by manually cycling the bed
stages.title_ja: ベッドを手動で往復させてZ動作を確認
stages.note: Manually cycle the bed through its range and check for resistance. Follow the manual if real hardware binds; a displayed source pose does not certify free travel, alignment or clearance.
stages.note_ja: 実機のベッドを手動で全行程往復させ、抵抗を確認します。引っ掛かる場合は説明書に従って調整してください。元CADの表示だけで自由な動き、整列、クリアランスを認定することはできません。

stages.title: Fit the left XY joint inserts
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントにインサートを入れる
stages.note: Fit the two original heat-set inserts slightly below the printed surface. Set this body aside while building the bearing stack.
stages.note_ja: 元の熱圧入インサート2個を、印刷部品の表面より少し低く入れます。この部品はベアリングの重ね組みが終わるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Build the left XY bearing stacks upside down
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントを逆さに重ね組み
stages.note: Use the matching printed plate, two M3x25 screws, four F623 bearings, eight shims and the original spacers. Keep the illustrated mirrored bearing levels.
stages.note_ja: 対応する印刷部品、M3x25を2本、F623ベアリング4個、シム8枚と元のスペーサーを使います。左右でベアリング高さが逆になる説明図を確認します。

stages.title: Close the left XY joint
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントを閉じる
stages.note: Bring back the same body with its two inserts and fit the original M2x10 self-tapping screw. Keep the two mirrored joint bodies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: インサート2個を入れた同じ部品を戻し、元のM2x10タッピングネジを取り付けます。左右のジョイント部品を取り違えないようにします。

stages.title: Check the left XY joint internal gap
stages.title_ja: 左XYジョイントの内寸を確認
stages.note: Check the illustrated 19 mm gap between the two inner printed faces. The complete prepared joint stays aside until it is attached to the X extrusion.
stages.note_ja: 内側の印刷面どうしの間隔が、説明図の19 mmになっていることを確認します。組み終えたジョイントは、X押出材へ取り付けるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Fit the right XY joint inserts
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントにインサートを入れる
stages.note: Fit the two original heat-set inserts slightly below the printed surface. Set this body aside while building the bearing stack.
stages.note_ja: 元の熱圧入インサート2個を、印刷部品の表面より少し低く入れます。この部品はベアリングの重ね組みが終わるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Build the right XY bearing stacks upside down
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントを逆さに重ね組み
stages.note: Use the matching printed plate, two M3x25 screws, four F623 bearings, eight shims and the original spacers. Keep the illustrated mirrored bearing levels.
stages.note_ja: 対応する印刷部品、M3x25を2本、F623ベアリング4個、シム8枚と元のスペーサーを使います。左右でベアリング高さが逆になる説明図を確認します。

stages.title: Close the right XY joint
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントを閉じる
stages.note: Bring back the same body with its two inserts and fit the original M2x10 self-tapping screw. Keep the two mirrored joint bodies on their specified sides.
stages.note_ja: インサート2個を入れた同じ部品を戻し、元のM2x10タッピングネジを取り付けます。左右のジョイント部品を取り違えないようにします。

stages.title: Check the right XY joint internal gap
stages.title_ja: 右XYジョイントの内寸を確認
stages.note: Check the illustrated 19 mm gap between the two inner printed faces. The complete prepared joint stays aside until it is attached to the X extrusion.
stages.note_ja: 内側の印刷面どうしの間隔が、説明図の19 mmになっていることを確認します。組み終えたジョイントは、X押出材へ取り付けるまで別に置きます。

stages.title: Mount the X rail and preload joint nuts
stages.note: Reuse the prepared fifth nut carrier. Centre the X rail at the illustrated 25 mm end offset and preload the joint slots. Keep the carriage captive. All six source XY-joint nuts are retained here.

stages.title: Attach XY joints loosely to the X extrusion
stages.note: Keep all six extrusion fixing screws loose until the XY joints meet the Y carriages; check the mirrored bearing levels. Sensorless X/Y setup is outside this static map.

stages.title: Attach the gantry to the Y carriages
stages.note: Spread joints outward at the rear position, then attach all eight countersunk rail-carriage screws.

stages.title: Square and check the gantry
stages.note: Move rearward against both drives before tightening the six joint screws, then check free front-to-back travel and derack if necessary. This is a manual check, not an automated clearance pass.

stages.title: Install the two upper side members
stages.title_ja: 上側の横材2本を取り付け
stages.note: Use the two original B frame members with their preloaded nuts. Keep the front and rear M3x10 screws for the following operations.
stages.note_ja: 先入れナットを入れた元のB横材2本を使います。前後のM3x10は、続く固定工程で使います。

stages.title: Remove both cam locks for screw access
stages.title_ja: ネジを締めるため両カムロックを外す
stages.note: Temporarily remove both original cam locks as shown. Set them aside for refitting after the front screws.
stages.note_ja: 説明書どおり両方の元カムロックを一時的に外します。前側のネジを締めた後、同じ部品を戻します。

stages.title: Fasten the front ends of the upper members
stages.title_ja: 上側横材の前端をネジで固定
stages.note: Install the two original front M3x10 screws while the cam locks are removed.
stages.note_ja: カムロックを外した状態で、元の前側M3x10を2本取り付けます。

stages.title: Refit the same two cam locks
stages.title_ja: 同じカムロック2個を戻す
stages.note: Refit both cam locks removed in the preceding operation; these are the same original parts.
stages.note_ja: 前の工程で外した、同じ元カムロック2個を戻します。

stages.title: Fasten the rear ends of the upper members
stages.title_ja: 上側横材の後端をネジで固定
stages.note: Install the two original rear M3x10 screws through the drive housings into the upper frame members.
stages.note_ja: 元の後側M3x10を2本、ドライブハウジングから上側横材へ取り付けます。

stages.title: Prepare the X carriage and retained captive hardware
stages.note: Remove the built-in print support before use. The r1 source exports it as a separate leaf; the V0.2 carriage is a composite source leaf. Support is retained in inventory only and must not be treated as installed hardware.

stages.title: Fit the MakerBeam belt clamps loosely
stages.note: Match FHCS length convention and leave clamps loose for threading. Start with equal belt lengths; slacken drive tensioners before routing.

stages.title: Route the lower A belt
stages.note: A is below B. Follow the complete manual route; belt contact belongs on bearing races and pulley teeth, not printed bodies. Only the final routed belt mesh appears here.

stages.title: Route the upper B belt
stages.note: B is above A. Secure equal tooth-tail counts without final trimming yet; avoid plastic contact. The map does not simulate threading or tension.

stages.title: Fasten the carriage to the X rail block
stages.note: Use the four source carriage screws with a small metal-only threadlocker application; excess threadlocker can damage ABS.

stages.title: Equalize belt tension and trim tails
stages.note: Use the manual 110 Hz reference at the indicated 150 mm spans with the gantry rearward. Equalize both belts before final trimming; tail clearance depends on the hotend.

stages.title: Prepare the bed adjustment knobs
stages.note: Install the three knob inserts. The two drag-chain spacer inserts were assigned in early bed-carrier preparation.

stages.title: Orient the build plate
stages.note: The single mounting hole faces front and counterbores face upward.

stages.title: Apply the magnetic sheet
stages.note: Clean and press the adhesive sheet onto the plate; keep mounting-screw access available. Final CAD adhesion is shown without an ingress animation.

stages.title: Apply the bed heater
stages.note: Clean the plate and centre the heater on its underside. The displayed plate remains at its final pose rather than flipping through installed parts.

stages.title: Review the thermal fuse protection
stages.note: r1 describes an inline fuse attached to the heater pad with RTV. No separate fuse leaf or wiring is identifiable in this export; protection remains unverified.

stages.title: Install and lock bed mounting bolts
stages.note: Lock the three bolts against rotation with their nuts and washers. Alternative bed frames require their own bolt-length and Z-clearance review.

stages.title: Install the sprung bed and flex plate
stages.note: Fit the three bed springs and adjustment knobs to the stock carrier. The flex plate is a source build-surface layer, not a separately illustrated new assembly instruction.

stages.title: Route and secure bed wires
stages.note: Route individual heater and thermistor wires through the nut-block guide and tie loops. The export does not supply a complete wiring harness; wire separation and flex clearance remain unverified.

stages.title: Reconnect the bed drag chain
stages.note: Reuse both end connectors and reconnect the eleven source links. At the highest bed position the chain must stay below the Z extrusion tops so the gantry can pass; static geometry does not certify a swept envelope.

stages.title: Prepare Mini Stealthburner shells and inserts
stages.note: Use the source printed bodies and protect surrounding plastic while setting inserts; the shuttle insert remains in tension. Prepare the anti-squish screw as shown.

stages.title: Prepare the guidler and BMG idler
stages.note: Remove the guidler print support, lubricate needle bearings, orient the larger gear section correctly, and check the shaft/bearing slip fit. The shaft short end must be below 3 mm.

stages.title: Assemble the extruder gear train
stages.note: Retain the captive nut without gluing bearings; keep the guidler pivot free. Centre the 50T gear with the illustrated clearance and align the drive teeth to the filament path before securing its grub screw.

stages.title: Fit and check extruder tension
stages.note: Seat the latch in the shuttle groove. Check light filament tooth marks and the anti-squish stop; excessive spring tension or binding is not acceptable.

stages.title: Fit all three stock head fans
stages.note: Both blowers discharge into the ducts; the axial fan pushes into the cowling. Preserve the illustrated wire exits and routes.

stages.title: Source CAD supplement: nozzle LEDs
stages.note: The pinned CAD contains two Adafruit Sequin assemblies. These pages provide nearby fan context, not LED assembly instructions. LED fixation, wiring and clearance remain open.

stages.title: Fit motor and adjust gear backlash
stages.note: Leave the slotted motor fixing loose while adjusting gear mesh; retain slight backlash after tightening and repeat the filament feeding check.

stages.title: Assemble the exact Revo Voron hotend
stages.note: Only the imported Revo Voron branch is represented. Use its four source screws and specific mount; cut captured PTFE to protrude 6 mm above the mount. Other hotend names are not fit evidence.

stages.title: Fasten the hotend and cowling
stages.note: Use the two long source cowling fixings and prepared captive carriage nuts. Check source-specific fan/duct/nozzle assembly before mounting.

stages.title: Mount the toolhead on the carriage
stages.note: Use both front carriage attachment screws and the native rear attachment fixing. The manual insertion arrow is not an evaluated trajectory; no continuously clear path is asserted.

stages.title: Attach stock strain relief and standoffs
stages.note: Prepare the two spacers with four end inserts as shown in the earlier component-preparation section; introduce them together here at their final positions. Standoffs use exposed motor-screw threads. Separate heater and thin signal/fan wires, with minimal slack at the front; the complete harness is absent.

stages.title: Source CAD supplement: generic ADXL assembly
stages.note: The pinned source includes this optional sensor, mount, spacers and screws; the manual pages are wiring context only. Physical installation instructions and coexistence with stock strain-relief fixings are not established here.

stages.title: Install the mid panel
stages.note: Reuse the six preloaded upright nuts; show the source panel at its final pose. Temporary printer inversion for nut positioning is not animated.

stages.title: Prepare the two electronics mounts
stages.note: Prepare inserts, DIN clips and cleats for the source SKR Pico and Raspberry Pi. The direct VHB mounting method is an alternative, not another installed bracket set.

stages.title: Attach SKR Pico and Raspberry Pi
stages.note: Board internal package/pin leaves form purchased source subassemblies and are introduced together, not individually assembled by the user. The SKR E3 wiring option is not an exported board variant.

stages.title: Check voltage and place the power supply
stages.note: Check the PSU voltage selector against the official diagram; maintain the indicated 1–2 mm frame gap. VHB and screw mounting are alternatives; tape is not modeled.

stages.title: Mount the controller cooling fan
stages.note: Use the two source printed mount halves, inserts and the separate 3010 fan with its exact fixing hardware.

stages.title: Wire and install the mains inlet
stages.note: Keep the machine unplugged; qualified personnel must follow local rules and the official mains/protective-earth diagram. AC, protective earth and DC ground are distinct. Harness and terminal safety are not validated by this model.

stages.title: Connect DC, motors, sensors and fans
stages.note: Use the SKR Pico diagram for the exported board. Verify fan voltage, polarity, motor identity, DIAG jumpers and Pi power. No full electrical harness or tested wiring is represented.

stages.title: Fit the PSU terminal guard
stages.note: Fit the source finger guard after wiring checks; its presence does not certify electrical safety.

stages.title: Fit the right skirt
stages.note: Use the retained slot nuts and source screws; rear screws need a ball-end driver.

stages.title: Fit the left skirt
stages.note: Use the retained slot nuts and source screws; rear screws need a ball-end driver.

stages.title: Fit the rear skirt
stages.note: Use the retained slot nuts and source screws; rear screws need a ball-end driver.

stages.title: Fit the front skirt
stages.note: Leave the central display space free and fit the logo accents.

stages.title: Source alternative: display blank insert
stages.note: This blank is the manual no-display alternative. Do not display it simultaneously with the installed display faceplate. Inventory only when excluded by the native variant mask; excluded parts stay hidden.

stages.title: Assemble and mount the V0 display
stages.note: Fit the diffuser, PCB, source mount/feet, knob and fasteners; reuse the two retained frame-slot nuts. Protect the fragile USB connector. V0.2 and r1 have different printed display mounts.

stages.title: Fit the bottom panel
stages.note: Remove and then refit rubber feet around this operation. Rotate the panel if the asymmetric mounting pattern does not align; no intermediate crossing motion is shown.

stages.title: Fit motor panel and strain-relief passage
stages.note: Route the bundle and Bowden tube through the cutout before fastening; reuse the source central cable-tie body. Toolhead-PCB replacement panels are a separate branch.

stages.title: Fit the spool holder
stages.note: Reuse the preloaded slot location and cut the source upper PTFE liner flush. The filament spool is excluded from the exported machine.

stages.title: Check reverse Bowden route
stages.note: Use the manual reverse-feed route; r1 sensor foot requires separate tube pieces. No full external reverse-Bowden tube leaf is exported.

stages.title: Fit rear panels, clips and lower tophat hinges
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm split panels and clips; stock clips do not require VHB. Additional tape thickness needs different clips, which are not imported.

stages.title: Fit the right clear side panel
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm panel and matching clips; right side includes the slip-door hinge pieces. Stock side clips do not need VHB.

stages.title: Fit the left clear side panel
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm panel and matching clips; right side includes the slip-door hinge pieces. Stock side clips do not need VHB.

stages.title: Fit door latch bodies and magnets
stages.note: Check all latch magnets attract the handle magnets before fixing them. CAD polarity is not an electrical or magnetic test.

stages.title: Fit the slip hinges and front panel
stages.note: Use VHB at the illustrated clips and the exact long hinge bolts. The slip hinge should allow upward removal; do not strip the lower plastic threads.

stages.title: Fit door handle and matching magnets
stages.note: Verify magnetic attraction before bonding the handle. Door sweep and removal paths are not validated.

stages.title: Prepare and square the tophat frame
stages.note: The r1 manual calls horizontal/vertical members B/J, while the CAD retains A/H names. Match 200 mm/80 mm source occurrences; preload top and outward slots and set front lock screw projection to 5 mm.

stages.title: Check every tophat slot preload
stages.note: Check the two illustrated nuts on each of all four sides before closing the panels. These are exact source clip/hinge hardware subgroups retained early at final positions.

stages.title: Fit the top panel and clips
stages.note: Use the 3 mm top panel and source corner clips; no VHB is required with stock clips.

stages.title: Fit front and side tophat panels
stages.note: Use the source 3 mm panels and clips. Upper and lower fixing identities stay with their corresponding panel edge.

stages.title: Fit the rear panel and upper hinges
stages.note: Rear panel goes opposite the projecting front lock screws. Leave upper hinges adjustable until their lower mates align.

stages.title: Attach hinge pivots and cam-lock fixings
stages.note: Carefully thread the source M3x12 pivots into the plastic lower hinges; do not overtighten. Reuse early hinge/clip nuts and lower hinge bodies.

stages.title: Check tophat opening and locking
stages.note: Check free opening with cam locks open before a clockwise 90-degree lock turn. r1 uses a 5 mm hex key; static stages do not certify a clear opening sweep.

stages.title: Mechanical assembly reference complete
stages.note: Follow the official documentation for electrical checks, configuration and initial startup. Inventory includes source alternatives and optional groups; their union is not a simultaneously buildable or collision-free configuration.
